resources.string: Thot reads your current screen to provide AI-powered context explanations and task automation. No data is stored without your consent.
Reads screen content to power context-aware AI responses
No API key set — using local mode
Overlay permission required to show floating button
Accessibility permission required to read screen context
Tap Browse to pick a .gguf (llama.cpp) or .task (MediaPipe) file — or paste a path manually
Before you enable the Screen Reader

Thot uses Android's Accessibility Service to read the visible text on your screen. This is required so the AI can understand what you are looking at and provide helpful, context-aware responses.


What data is collected
 • The visible text on your screen (e.g. messages, article content, form labels).
 • The name of the app currently in the foreground.


How this data is used
 • The captured text is included in the prompt that is sent to your chosen AI provider (OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, or the on-device model) only when you tap the Thot button.
 • It is not stored on the device beyond the current session, and is not shared with any third party other than the AI provider you have selected.


What Thot does NOT do
 • Does not record passwords, payment details, or any data you type.
 • Does not run continuously in a way that logs your activity.
 • Does not upload data in the background.


You can disable the Accessibility Service at any time in
 Settings → Accessibility → Thot AI Assistant.
Works out of the box — no account needed
Thot\'s built-in offline mode processes everything on your device. No API key or internet connection required. You can optionally connect a smarter AI provider below.
✓ No API key needed. Responses are generated on your device using pattern matching. For smarter AI, choose another option below.
Requires an API key from the provider\'s website. Your screen context is sent to their servers when you use Thot.
Runs a full language model on your phone. Free and private, but requires downloading a model file (800 MB–2 GB).
